battle-results-text: Both teams’ ratings and languages beside the results table, with each team’s average, anonymized players included.
data-linking: Linking your account is optional. It opens your own browser and signs you in with the game’s Wargaming sign-in; that token goes from the game to Wargaming only, never to {name}.
data-ratings: To {name}: the account ids and clan tags of the players on your screen, to get their ratings and languages. Nothing else about you unless you link your account.
data-twitch: Your Twitch chat is read anonymously from Twitch. Messages you write go through {name} with the Twitch permission you granted, which you can revoke in your Twitch settings.
description: The {name} mod for World of Tanks: every player’s WN8 or WNX and the languages of their clan in battle, on the Tab and loading screens, in the battle results and across the garage, plus your Twitch chat in game. Free and open source.
download-note: Free and open source. Hosted on Wargaming's official mod hub, which always names the client version it is built for.
faq-allowed-answer: It shows public statistics only: ratings anyone can look up and the languages clans declare. It reveals nothing the game hides, such as enemy positions or reload timers, automates nothing in battle, and is distributed through wgmods.net, Wargaming’s official mod hub.
faq-free-answer: Yes, free and open source, with no account needed. Linking your {name} account is only for writing in your Twitch chat from the game.
faq-hide-answer: Yes. Each screen can show ratings always or only while Alt is held, you choose whose ratings show per battle mode, and every surface can be turned off in the settings.
faq-ratings-answer: WN7, WN8 or WNX, overall or over the last 30 days, computed exactly like on {name} and coloured by the same bands.
faq-ratings-question: Which ratings does the mod show?
faq-servers-answer: Yes. The mod follows the server your game client plays on and asks {name} for that region’s ratings.
faq-servers-question: Does it work on the EU, NA and Asia servers?
hero: WN8, WNX and every player’s languages, right in World of Tanks
in-battle-text: WN7, WN8 or WNX and clan languages in the players panel, the Tab and loading screens and above vehicles, with team averages. Choose whose ratings you see per mode, or show them only while Alt is held.
in-the-garage-text: Ratings and flags in your contacts, profiles, skirmish rooms and Stronghold, and a tank menu button that opens the tank’s page, marks and build on the site.
install-step-1: Download the archive and unzip it into your World of Tanks folder.
install-step-2: Start the game. The first start restarts it once, to register the garage button.
og-title: World of Tanks WN8 & WNX mod
screenshot-battle-markers: Ratings and language flags by the player names above vehicles, always or only while Alt is held.
screenshot-battle-players: Each player’s rating and clan languages beside the Tab screen, with both teams’ averages.
screenshot-garage: The garage with the unicum.gg account card and your Twitch chat, under the mission cards.
screenshot-garage-cards: The account card and the Twitch chat panel, which you can move, fold or close.
screenshot-twitch-chat: Your Twitch chat in the battle chat, viewer badges included, and the TO TWITCH channel to write back.
subtitle: The {name} mod shows each player’s WN8 or WNX and the languages their clan speaks, in battle, in the battle results and in the garage, and brings your Twitch chat into the game.
title: World of Tanks WN8 & WNX mod
twitch-text: Your Twitch chat, badges included, in the battle chat and in a garage panel. Write back from the battle chat’s TO TWITCH channel or the panel, without leaving the game.
what-it-sends: What the mod sends, and to whom
install-included: Nothing else to install: openwg_gameface, which the garage features need, is in the archive and goes to the right place on its own.
install-optional-settings: adds the in-game settings window. Without it, the settings are in mods/configs/unicum/settings.json.
